clips.title: The story
paras: At Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage gathers sacred waters for Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus. The Filled Vessel carries samples from Teldrassil’s moonwells to aid his study of the World Tree’s ailments.

Night elf acolytes gather water from moonwells across Teldrassil. The tree was planted without the blessings of the Great Aspects, Alexstrasza and Nozdormu, leaving its boughs open to corruption, strange beasts, and crazed furbolg tribes. Corithras Moonrage gathers the phials in Dolanaar and pours them into the Filled Vessel for the journey to the capital. Together, the waters offer a vital sample of Teldrassil’s vitality. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm studies them in the Cenarion Enclave, seeking a remedy for the Great Tree’s flaws.
